Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SPATULA, EYE. CYCLODIALYSIS, SINCLAIR'S PATTERN 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional end other requirements for Sinciair's pattern cyclodialysis spatula 
used in eye surgery. 



2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

3. Material 

3.1 B/aofe — Shall be made from stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 
' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

3.2 Handle — Shall confomi to Type HI of IS : 7783-1975. 

4. Worlimanehip and Finish 

4.1 The spatula shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks, etc.

IS: 7767. 1975 

4.t The edges ehall be even and rounded. 

4.3 The working end shall be a curved graduated blade with a rounded tip. The graduations shall be 
clearly marked at the working end of the spatula. 

4^4 The spatula shall be polished bright and passivated. 

4.5 The shank of the spatula shall be fixed to the handle conforming to IS : 7783-1976. The cdHar 
shall be 3*2 mm die. 

4.6 The silver soldering of the shank to the handle after push fitting shall be neat and sound. 

5. Heat Treatment — The spatula shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 
380 to 450 HV. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test ~- The spatula shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as specified 
in IS : 7631-1975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments '. 

7. Marking — Each spatula shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name or 
Initials or recognized trade-mark, and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 /5/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
